input: V-004 S2-s1 RAW (motion correct, legs ghost in segment frames 18-27 and weakly 42)
user_verdict_v005: R1 (LTX refine) and R3 (2-frame anchors) both insufficient
hypothesis: LTX VAE 32x spatial / 8x temporal compression makes thin fast legs sub-token; Wan (8x spatial with 2x2 patch = 16px token, 4x temporal) is finer

common.runner: DiffSynth (V-002) preferred; else minimal patch to official Wan code, diff in RUNTIME_WAN.md
common.method: video-to-video: encode input, mix noise to strength s, denoise to end
common.prompt: V-004 S2 prompt + ' Sharp, clearly defined legs and paws.'
common.precision: bf16 only; convert fp32 to bf16 safetensors first and record hash

record: expert boundary and confirmation that only low-noise expert is needed
sigma_check_before_generation.stop_if: W1-a and W1-b actual start sigma are equal

legs_only.region: lower 45% of output Lab SAM bbox, dilated 12px, feather 8px

metrics.leg_sharpness: V-005 section 5.1 (semi-transparency ratio, boundary Laplacian variance); frames 14-34 mean/max, others mean, per-frame plot; baselines S2-s1, V-005 R1, V-005 R3-s1
metrics.motion_retention: per-frame Lab mask IoU vs S2-s1, scaled Lab IoU, kick direction agreement 20-34
metrics.seam: consecutive-frame difference spikes at frames 8-13 and 35-40
metrics.latent_shapes: actual latent C/T/H/W and token counts for LTX stage 1, LTX stage 2, Wan
metrics.cost: steps, time, peak memory, hw.csv peaks

ops.start_conditions: V-001 section 7: MemAvailable >= 112GiB, drop-caches, expandable_segments, NVRM watch stop on first, MemoryHigh = MemoryMax
ops.time_projection: from first-step time; if projected > 60 min per run then BLOCKED_TIME, no resolution downgrade
ops.download: official sources only, keep >= 200GiB free, record hashes

viewer.top_line: 먼저 볼 것: RAW, 다리 구간 반복(14~34), 0.25배속, 다리 확대로 S2-s1과 W들을 비교

dataset_record: V-005 section 7.2 rule; add parent_sample linking to S2-s1 SAMPLE; update SCHEMA.md

budget.interim_delivery: after W1-a (both reinsertion derivatives + leg zoom comparison)

config_separation_rule: all scene-specific values live only in this file; code reads them, never hardcodes

measurement_extension.frame_statistics_scope: RAW refinement frames only; outside means outside main window within refined33
